finding: Application code references workflow_instance_id and departments.node_type supplied by migrations dated after the audit date; production schema status is unknown.
impact: A release built from mismatched code/schema may fail at runtime or leave features inconsistent.
remediation: Pin application commit and migration set; verify in an isolated staging copy and create an explicit compatibility/release gate.
validation: Compare schema metadata and migration status in approved staging, then run targeted feature tests; do not query or migrate production as part of this audit.

finding: Guardian civil-registry client is bound to an Unavailable implementation, so automated identity verification is not delivered by this repository build.
impact: Eligibility may remain pending/manual; describing it as automated verification could cause identity/integrity errors.
remediation: Approve a documented manual process or implement an authorized, contract-tested provider before enabling automated verification.
validation: Use a mock and an approved sandbox; test unavailable, timeout, invalid response, and positive verification without real beneficiary data.

finding: Sensitive attachments are validated by type/size and stored privately, but no malware scanning implementation was found in the correspondence upload path.
impact: A malicious or malformed document may reach a user who downloads or prints it; MIME validation alone is insufficient.
remediation: Add quarantine/scanning policy and safe download release flow; enforce least privilege and retain audit records.
validation: Test benign and synthetic EICAR test files in a controlled environment and verify blocked/quarantined states.

finding: No repository evidence establishes production TLS/reverse proxy, backup/restore, RPO/RTO, monitoring, or scheduled worker operation.
evidence: Repository root inventory; bootstrap/app.php:14-18; routes/console.php; config/queue.php
impact: Outage, data loss, missed reminders/synchronization, or unobserved failures may not be recoverable.
remediation: Document target topology, secrets handling, TLS, backups and recovery; require a successful restore drill and scheduler/worker health checks.
validation: Perform a restore exercise from a protected backup and record RPO/RTO; verify TLS from an authorized non-sensitive health check.

finding: Authorization is implemented through multiple custom services rather than a single policy layer; broad sensitive-data boundaries and actor/decision separation have not been comprehensively tested.
impact: Cross-department data exposure or separation-of-duties errors could go undetected; no specific exploitable bypass was confirmed in this audit.
remediation: Build a route/action × actor matrix and feature-test direct requests, exports, downloads, print payloads, delegation expiry and self-approval.
validation: Run tests with synthetic multi-role users and departments on an isolated DB; verify deny-by-default for unassigned capabilities.

finding: The read-only Node suite has one reproducible applied-filter removal failure: channel and direction remain when expected to be removed.
impact: Users may see stale filters/incorrect list state after removing a filter.
remediation: Fix the state-normalization logic and add regression coverage in a separate implementation task.
validation: Re-run node --test tests/*.test.mjs; require all 32 tests to pass.

finding: A source test exercises concurrent allocation in two independent processes, but it was not run here and does not cover the full correspondence issuance transaction, action, assignment and audit lifecycle.
impact: The allocator has source-level concurrency coverage, but lifecycle-level regressions or test/environment failures remain unknown; historical test notes conflict with the current test source.
remediation: Run the existing allocator concurrency test in an isolated PostgreSQL test environment; add a separate end-to-end issuance concurrency assertion only if the release criteria require it.
validation: Run parallel full issuance requests on a disposable DB and assert unique references plus consistent actions, assignments and audit rows; never use production data.

finding: The example/config defaults do not enable session encryption; production settings and encryption at rest for database/files are not evidenced.
impact: If production inherits defaults, sensitive session data may not receive Laravel session encryption; DB/file encryption is also unverified.
remediation: Confirm production session encryption and document database/filesystem encryption, key ownership, rotation and backups; never publish key values.
validation: Inspect approved deployment configuration without exposing secrets and verify encryption controls with platform owners.
status: UNKNOWN / example is not production evidence

finding: Print layout checks are source/HTML/CSS assertions only; actual PDF pagination, repeated footer geometry and browser-generated print headers were not tested.
impact: Footer collision, pagination differences or browser print headers may remain browser-dependent.
remediation: Use an approved structural PDF test or server-generated paginated PDF if a reliable repeated-footer guarantee is required.
validation: Generate a safe synthetic-content PDF in a controlled test environment and assert per-page content boxes; no screenshots.

finding: HotSMS response handling does not prove carrier delivery; a successful HTTP response may not equal delivered notification.
impact: Users may believe a time-sensitive notice was delivered when provider/carrier rejected it later.
remediation: Model provider acceptance and delivery receipts separately; surface retries/failures and maintain idempotency.
validation: Use provider sandbox or mocked accepted/rejected/delayed responses; no personal phone numbers.
